# Route reference

<!-- Generated by `go test ./internal/server -run TestRouteReference -update-routes`; do not edit. -->

Every route the gateway serves, generated from the handlers in `internal/server`. Contracts, errors and headers are described in the [API specification](../api.md); this page is the complete list, so a route missing here does not exist.

## Model API

| Method | Path | Handler | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/v1/audio/speech` | `s.model(provider.Speech)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `POST` | `/v1/audio/transcriptions` | `s.model(provider.Transcriptions)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `POST` | `/v1/audio/translations` | `s.model(provider.Translations)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `GET` | `/v1/batches` | `s.listBatches` | listBatches lists the caller's batches, newest first, as last stored. |
| `POST` | `/v1/batches` | `s.createBatch` | createBatch starts a batch on the target that holds its input file. |
| `GET` | `/v1/batches/{id}` | `s.batchCall(http.MethodGet, "")` | batchCall serves retrieve and cancel on a batch, at its target, and keeps the stored batch current. |
| `POST` | `/v1/batches/{id}/cancel` | `s.batchCall(http.MethodPost, "/cancel")` | batchCall serves retrieve and cancel on a batch, at its target, and keeps the stored batch current. |
| `POST` | `/v1/chat/completions` | `s.model(provider.ChatCompletions)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `POST` | `/v1/embeddings` | `s.model(provider.Embeddings)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `GET` | `/v1/files` | `s.listFiles` | listFiles lists the caller's files, newest first, as recorded. |
| `POST` | `/v1/files` | `s.uploadFile` | uploadFile checks a batch input file and uploads it to the first target of its model that accepts it. |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/files/{id}` | `s.fileCall(http.MethodDelete, "")` | fileCall serves retrieve, delete and content on a file, at the target that holds it. |
| `GET` | `/v1/files/{id}` | `s.fileCall(http.MethodGet, "")` | fileCall serves retrieve, delete and content on a file, at the target that holds it. |
| `GET` | `/v1/files/{id}/content` | `s.fileCall(http.MethodGet, "/content")` | fileCall serves retrieve, delete and content on a file, at the target that holds it. |
| `POST` | `/v1/images/edits` | `s.model(provider.ImageEdits)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `POST` | `/v1/images/generations` | `s.model(provider.ImageGenerations)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `POST` | `/v1/messages` | `s.model(provider.Messages)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `GET` | `/v1/models` | `s.listModels` | listModels lists the virtual models the caller's key may use, in OpenAI's shape. |
| `POST` | `/v1/moderations` | `s.model(provider.Moderations)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `GET` | `/v1/realtime` | `s.realtime` | realtime relays an OpenAI realtime session to one target, charging each response as it finishes (docs/modalities.md). |
| `POST` | `/v1/rerank` | `s.model(provider.Rerank)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `POST` | `/v1/responses` | `s.model(provider.Responses)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `GET` | `/v1/videos` | `s.listVideos` | listVideos lists the caller's jobs, newest first, as last stored. |
| `POST` | `/v1/videos` | `s.model(provider.Videos)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/videos/{id}` | `s.videoJob(http.MethodDelete, "")` | videoJob serves retrieve, delete and content on a job, at the target that created it. |
| `GET` | `/v1/videos/{id}` | `s.videoJob(http.MethodGet, "")` | videoJob serves retrieve, delete and content on a job, at the target that created it. |
| `GET` | `/v1/videos/{id}/content` | `s.videoJob(http.MethodGet, "/content")` | videoJob serves retrieve, delete and content on a job, at the target that created it. |
| `POST` | `/v1/videos/{id}/remix` | `s.model(provider.VideoRemix)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |
| `POST` | `/v1beta/models/{action}` | `s.model(provider.GenerateContent)` | model serves one model endpoint: authenticate, check policy, route, stream the answer back and record usage. |

## MCP gateway

| Method | Path | Handler | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/mcp/connect/callback` | `s.connectCallback` | connectCallback finishes the flow: it exchanges the code and stores the user's tokens. |
| `GET` | `/mcp/connect/{id}` | `s.connectStart` | connectStart serves the link a user opens: it checks who they are when it can, then sends them to the upstream's consent page. |
| `ANY` | `/mcp/{name}` | `s.serveMCP` | serveMCP authenticates and authorizes a request to a virtual MCP server, then hands it to the MCP gateway. |

## Admin API

| Method | Path | Handler | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/alerts` | `s.listAlerts` | listAlerts lists fired alerts, optionally for one organization or event. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/alerts/test` | `s.testAlert` | testAlert sends a test event to one webhook and reports the result. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/alerts/webhooks` | `s.listWebhooks` | listWebhooks is for owners: a webhook can be limited to one organization, and its name and host say whom it notifies. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/audit` | `s.listAudit` | listAudit lists audit log entries, newest first, optionally for one organization. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/batches` | `s.listAdminBatches` | listAdminBatches lists batches for operators, newest first. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/batches/{id}/cancel` | `s.cancelAdminBatch` | cancelAdminBatch cancels a batch at its target, for operators who can write to its organization. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/cache` | `s.clearCache` | clearCache removes an organization's or a team's cached answers. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/catalog` | `s.listCatalog` | listCatalog returns the provider presets and model prices the setup wizard and configuration forms fill in from (docs/catalog.md). |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/config` | `s.listConfig` | listConfig lists every configuration object with where it comes from: the config file, the store, or both. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/config/{kind}/{name}` | `s.deleteConfig` | deleteConfig removes an object from the running config: a stored one is deleted, and one from the file gets a deletion marker (ADR 0028). |
| `PUT` | `/admin/v1/config/{kind}/{name}` | `s.putConfig` | putConfig creates or replaces a stored configuration object, validated against the merged config. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/config/{kind}/{name}/reset` | `s.resetConfig` | resetConfig removes the stored copy or deletion marker of a file object, so the file's version applies again. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/denials` | `s.listDenials` | listDenials lists recorded refusals the operator may read. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/directory` | `s.listDirectory` | listDirectory lists provisioned users with their groups, and the groups, for owners. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/explain` | `s.explain` | explain answers whether a key may make a request now, and why not. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/guardrail-events` | `s.listGuardrailEvents` | listGuardrailEvents serves GET /admin/v1/guardrail-events. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/guardrails` | `s.listGuardrails` | listGuardrails lists the configured guardrails without their secrets. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/keys` | `s.listAllKeys` | listAllKeys lists keys across teams, limited to the organizations the operator can read (docs/virtual-keys.md). |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/keys/{key_id}` | `s.getKey` | getKey returns one key's metadata and policy; the secret is never returned. |
| `PATCH` | `/admin/v1/keys/{key_id}` | `s.updateKey` | updateKey changes a key's name, owner, expiry or policy. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke` | `s.revokeKey` | revokeKey revokes a key at once. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate` | `s.rotateKey` | rotateKey gives a key a new secret; the old one works for a grace period, so applications can switch over without downtime. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/mcp/calls` | `s.listMCPCalls` | listMCPCalls lists audited MCP tool calls, newest first. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/mcp/catalog` | `s.mcpCatalog` | mcpCatalog lists the virtual MCP servers, with a team's access to each when team_id is given. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/mcp/connections` | `s.listMCPConnections` | listMCPConnections lists users' upstream MCP connections, without their tokens. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/mcp/connections/{server}/{subject}` | `s.deleteMCPConnection` | deleteMCPConnection revokes a connection at the upstream when it can, then deletes it. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/mcp/requests` | `s.listMCPRequests` | listMCPRequests lists MCP access requests of the teams the operator can read, newest first. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/mcp/requests` | `s.createMCPRequest` | createMCPRequest asks for a team's access to a virtual MCP server. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/mcp/requests/{request_id}/approve` | `s.approveMCPRequest` | approveMCPRequest approves a request and adds the server to the team's allowed MCP servers. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/mcp/requests/{request_id}/deny` | `s.denyMCPRequest` | denyMCPRequest denies a request with an optional note. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/mcp/servers` | `s.listMCPServers` | listMCPServers lists upstream MCP servers and their status. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/mcp/servers/{server}/tools/{tool}/approve` | `s.approveMCPTool` | approveMCPTool approves a pinned MCP tool's current definition. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/mcp/tools` | `s.listMCPTools` | listMCPTools lists upstream MCP tools with their pin and approval state. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/mcp/virtual-servers` | `s.listVirtualServers` | listVirtualServers lists virtual MCP servers and the tools each exposes. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/me` | `s.me` | me describes the signed-in operator: subject, roles and organizations. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/models` | `s.listConfiguredModels` | listConfiguredModels lists virtual models with their targets, endpoints and recent health. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/orgs` | `s.listOrgs` | listOrgs lists the organizations the operator may see. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/orgs` | `s.createOrg` | createOrg creates an organization with an optional policy. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}` | `s.deleteOrg` | deleteOrg deletes an organization; only owners may. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}` | `s.getOrg` | getOrg returns one organization and its policy. |
| `PATCH` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}` | `s.updateOrg` | updateOrg changes an organization. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}/cedar` | `s.deleteCedar` | deleteCedar removes an organization's Cedar policies, as a new empty version; only owners may. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}/cedar` | `s.getCedar` | getCedar returns an organization's Cedar policies in force, or a version given by ?version=. |
| `PUT` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}/cedar` | `s.putCedar` | putCedar saves a new version of an organization's Cedar policies; only owners may. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}/cedar/check` | `s.checkCedar` | checkCedar evaluates a request against an organization's Cedar policies, or against draft text, without sending it. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}/cedar/versions` | `s.listCedarVersions` | listCedarVersions lists the versions of an organization's Cedar policies, newest first. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}/teams` | `s.listTeams` | listTeams lists an organization's teams. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/orgs/{org_id}/teams` | `s.createTeam` | createTeam creates a team in an organization with an optional policy. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/playground/audio/speech` | `s.playground(provider.Speech)` | playground lets an operator call a model as a team, with the team's policies, through the same handler that serves API keys (docs/playground.md). |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/playground/audio/transcriptions` | `s.playground(provider.Transcriptions)` | playground lets an operator call a model as a team, with the team's policies, through the same handler that serves API keys (docs/playground.md). |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/playground/chat/completions` | `s.playground(provider.ChatCompletions)` | playground lets an operator call a model as a team, with the team's policies, through the same handler that serves API keys (docs/playground.md). |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/playground/images/generations` | `s.playground(provider.ImageGenerations)` | playground lets an operator call a model as a team, with the team's policies, through the same handler that serves API keys (docs/playground.md). |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/portal` | `s.portal` | portal returns, for each of the person's teams, what it may use, the person's keys and their use this month. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/portal/keys/{key_id}/revoke` | `s.portalRevokeKey` | portalRevokeKey revokes one of the person's keys at once. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/portal/keys/{key_id}/rotate` | `s.portalRotateKey` | portalRotateKey gives one of the person's keys a new secret; the old one works for the grace period, at most portalMaxGrace. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/portal/teams/{team_id}/keys` | `s.portalCreateKey` | portalCreateKey creates a key the person owns, with no policy of its own and an expiry within sso.portal.max_key_ttl. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/portal/teams/{team_id}/requests` | `s.portalRequestAccess` | portalRequestAccess asks the team's admins for a virtual MCP server, as the MCP catalog does. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/providers` | `s.listProviders` | listProviders lists configured providers with type, endpoint, auth kind and last-hour health; secrets are never returned. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/requests` | `s.deleteRequestBodies` | deleteRequestBodies deletes an organization's bodies before a time. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/requests` | `s.listRequests` | listRequests lists logged request bodies' metadata, newest first. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/requests/{request_id}` | `s.getRequestBody` | getRequestBody returns a request's logged body. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/sessions` | `s.deleteSessions` | deleteSessions signs out everyone else, or with ?subject= one user, for when someone leaves or a session may be stolen. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/settings` | `s.settings` | settings reports the gateway's own settings, for owners. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/teams/{team_id}` | `s.deleteTeam` | deleteTeam deletes a team. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/teams/{team_id}` | `s.getTeam` | getTeam returns one team and its policy. |
| `PATCH` | `/admin/v1/teams/{team_id}` | `s.updateTeam` | updateTeam changes a team's name or policy. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/teams/{team_id}/credentials` | `s.listTeamCredentials` | listTeamCredentials lists every provider with whether the team has its own credential for it. |
| `DELETE` | `/admin/v1/teams/{team_id}/credentials/{provider}` | `s.deleteTeamCredential` | deleteTeamCredential removes a team's own key for a provider. |
| `PUT` | `/admin/v1/teams/{team_id}/credentials/{provider}` | `s.putTeamCredential` | putTeamCredential stores a team's own key for a provider, encrypted. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/teams/{team_id}/keys` | `s.listKeys` | listKeys lists a team's keys without their secrets. |
| `POST` | `/admin/v1/teams/{team_id}/keys` | `s.createKey` | createKey creates a key in a team and returns its secret once. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/usage` | `s.queryUsage` | queryUsage sums usage and cost over a time range, grouped by model, team, key, provider, endpoint or day. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/usage/export` | `s.exportUsage` | exportUsage streams usage as CSV: format=chargeback (the default) or format=focus. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/usage/forecast` | `s.listForecasts` | listForecasts returns the forecast of each monthly budget the caller may see usage of. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/usage/rollups` | `s.exportRollups` | exportRollups streams the daily usage rollups, for loading into a warehouse (docs/analytics.md): JSON lines by default, or format=csv. |
| `GET` | `/admin/v1/videos` | `s.listAdminVideos` | listAdminVideos lists video jobs for operators, newest first. |

## Admin UI and sign-in

| Method | Path | Handler | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/ui` | `http.RedirectHandler("/ui/", http.StatusMovedPermanently)` | - |
| `GET` | `/ui/` | `s.serveUI` | serveUI serves the UI's files. |
| `GET` | `/ui/auth/callback` | `auth(s.callback)` | callback finishes the flow: it exchanges the code, verifies the ID token, resolves roles and starts a session. |
| `GET` | `/ui/auth/config` | `auth(s.authConfig)` | authConfig tells the sign-in page which methods are available. |
| `GET` | `/ui/auth/login` | `auth(s.login)` | login starts the authorization code flow with PKCE. |
| `POST` | `/ui/auth/logout` | `auth(s.logout)` | logout ends the session. |
| `POST` | `/ui/auth/saml/acs` | `auth(s.samlACS)` | samlACS takes the identity provider's signed response, resolves roles and starts a session. |
| `GET` | `/ui/auth/saml/login` | `auth(s.samlLogin)` | samlLogin sends the browser to the SAML identity provider with an AuthnRequest. |
| `GET` | `/ui/auth/saml/metadata` | `auth(s.samlMetadata)` | samlMetadata serves the gateway's SAML service provider metadata for the identity provider. |
| `GET` | `/ui/auth/saml/slo` | `auth(s.samlSLO)` | samlSLO is the gateway's single logout service: it takes the identity provider's LogoutRequests and its LogoutResponses to the gateway's own. |
| `POST` | `/ui/auth/saml/slo` | `auth(s.samlSLO)` | samlSLO is the gateway's single logout service: it takes the identity provider's LogoutRequests and its LogoutResponses to the gateway's own. |
| `POST` | `/ui/auth/token` | `auth(s.tokenLogin)` | tokenLogin signs in with the admin token when OIDC is not configured. |

## Discovery and operations

| Method | Path | Handler | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ANY` | `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp/{name}` | `s.mcpResourceMetadata` | mcpResourceMetadata serves RFC 9728 protected resource metadata for a virtual server, when OAuth is configured. |
| `POST` | `/a2a/{name}` | `s.serveA2A` | serveA2A relays a JSON-RPC request to an A2A agent: the caller must be allowed the agent, a task or context it names must be its own, and guardrails check the message (docs/a2a.md). |
| `GET` | `/a2a/{name}/.well-known/agent-card.json` | `s.a2aCard` | a2aCard serves an agent's card as seen through the gateway: the gateway's URL, JSON-RPC only, and a gateway key as the only way to authenticate (ADR 0033). |
| `GET` | `/a2a/{name}/.well-known/agent.json` | `s.a2aCard` | a2aCard serves an agent's card as seen through the gateway: the gateway's URL, JSON-RPC only, and a gateway key as the only way to authenticate (ADR 0033). |
| `POST` | `/a2a/{name}/push/{secret}` | `s.a2aPushNotify` | a2aPushNotify takes a notification from an agent and delivers it to the webhook of the caller that set the configuration. |
| `ANY` | `/a2a/{name}/{path...}` | `s.serveA2AREST` | serveA2AREST relays a request of the HTTP+JSON binding, with the same checks as serveA2A. |
| `GET` | `/bedrock/model/{model}/invoke-with-bidirectional-stream` | `s.bidi` | bidi relays a Bedrock bidirectional stream, as Nova Sonic uses, over a WebSocket: each message either way is one event's JSON, the payload Bedrock carries base64 encoded in its event stream. |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | `(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) literal)` | - |
| `GET` | `/metrics` | `s.MetricsHandler()` | MetricsHandler serves Prometheus metrics. |
| `GET` | `/readyz` | `s.readyz` | readyz answers 200 once keys are loaded, and 503 before that and while the gateway drains. |
